metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over Brooklyn, New York lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: We need tropospheric NO₂ column concentration data over Brooklyn, NY. We'll use the Sentinel-5P OFFL L3 product that provides NO2_tropospheric_column with daily global coverage (spatial resolution ~3.5 km). Periods to compare: - 2018 Oct 1–23 - 2019 Oct 1–23 - 2021 Oct 1–23 2. Masking strategy: The product is cloud-screened. We will additionally mask using the qa_value band: keep only pixels with qa_value >= 0.75 (common best-practice for Sentinel-5P NO₂). No further cloud layers needed because the question is about NO₂, not clouds. 3. Logic: Compute the mean tropospheric NO₂ column for each year over Brooklyn. Compare 2021 to 2018 and 2019. - If 2021 mean is strictly lower than both 2018 and 2019 → A (Yes) - If higher or equal to either → B (No) - If any collection is empty → C1 - If any period has 0 valid pixels after masking → C2 - If mean is None or NaN → C3 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time brooklyn = ee.Geometry.Point([-73.9442, 40.6782]) # central Brooklyn dates = {'2018': ('2018-10-01', '2018-10-24'), '2019': ('2019-10-01', '2019-10-24'), '2021': ('2021-10-01', '2021-10-24')} def get_mean(year): start, end = dates[year] col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select(['NO2_tropospheric_column', 'qa_value']) .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(brooklyn)) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None, 0 masked = col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75))) img_mean = masked.mean().multiply(1e6) # mol/m² → µmol/m² count = img_mean.select('NO2_tropospheric_column').reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=brooklyn, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NO2_tropospheric_column').getInfo() mean_val = img_mean.select('NO2_tropospheric_column').reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=brooklyn, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NO2_tropospheric_column').getInfo() return mean_val, count means = {} counts = {} for yr in ['2018', '2019', '2021']: v, c = get_mean(yr) if v is None: print(f"{yr}: C1 (empty)") print("C1") exit() if c == 0: print(f"{yr}: C2 (0 pixels)") print("C2") exit() means[yr], counts[yr] = v, c print(f"2018: {means['2018']:.3f} µmol/m² (pixels {counts['2018']})") print(f"2019: {means['2019']:.3f} µmol/m² (pixels {counts['2019']})") print(f"2021: {means['2021']:.3f} µmol/m² (pixels {counts['2021']})") if any(x is None for x in means.values()): print("C3") elif means['2021'] < means['2018'] and means['2021'] < means['2019']: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
brooklyn = ee.Geometry.Point([-73.9442, 40.6782])  # central Brooklyn
dates = {'2018': ('2018-10-01', '2018-10-24'),
         '2019': ('2019-10-01', '2019-10-24'),
         '2021': ('2021-10-01', '2021-10-24')}

def get_mean(year):
    start, end = dates[year]
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2')
           .select(['NO2_tropospheric_column', 'qa_value'])
           .filterDate(start, end)
           .filterBounds(brooklyn))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None, 0
    masked = col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75)))
    img_mean = masked.mean().multiply(1e6)  # mol/m² → µmol/m²
    count = img_mean.select('NO2_tropospheric_column').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=brooklyn, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NO2_tropospheric_column').getInfo()
    mean_val = img_mean.select('NO2_tropospheric_column').reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=brooklyn, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('NO2_tropospheric_column').getInfo()
    return mean_val, count

means = {}
counts = {}
for yr in ['2018', '2019', '2021']:
    v, c = get_mean(yr)
    if v is None:
        print(f"{yr}: C1 (empty)")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()
    if c == 0:
        print(f"{yr}: C2 (0 pixels)")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        exit()
    means[yr], counts[yr] = v, c

print(f"2018: {means['2018']:.3f} µmol/m² (pixels {counts['2018']})")
print(f"2019: {means['2019']:.3f} µmol/m² (pixels {counts['2019']})")
print(f"2021: {means['2021']:.3f} µmol/m² (pixels {counts['2021']})")

if any(x is None for x in means.values()):
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif means['2021'] < means['2018'] and means['2021'] < means['2019']:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
